name: SSWK: Valentine's Day Special
source:
Today, you have a date planned with your boyfriend... Will the two of you enjoy yourselves? Find out now!

This is a short, stand-alone story that takes place in an alternate universe from SSWK's main game.

[From [url=https://sswk.itch.io/sswk-vday-special1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天，你计划和你的男朋友约会……你们两个会玩得很开心吗？现在就知道吧！

这是一个简短的独立故事，发生在SSWK主游戏的另一个宇宙中。

[来自[url=https://sswk.itch.io/sswk-vday-special1]Itch.io[/url]]
